title: Sample-level genotype QC
description: Flag sample-level genotype defects and return a clean sample set. Scored on per-class F1, false removals, defect-severity ranking and runtime, so flagging everything is not a winning strategy.

title: Relatedness, duplicates and cryptic relatives
description: Separate duplicates, first-degree relatives and cryptic relatedness from unrelated pairs. Scored on pair ranking, kinship accuracy and relatedness class F1.

title: Ancestry, outliers and batch-artifact SNPs
description: Detect ancestry outliers and batch-artifact variants while estimating ancestry structure. Scored on outlier F1, ancestry and principal-component agreement, and artifact ranking.

title: Genotype-RNA record swaps
description: Find genotype-to-RNA record swaps across two data types. Scored on the paired-sample F1 and the ranking of suspect pairs.

title: Bulk RNA-seq quantification and differential expression
description: Quantify raw reads, assemble a count matrix and test a condition contrast across replicates. Scored on DE ranking, false-discovery control, effect accuracy and recall, so a permissive test does not win.

title: Isoform quantification and differential transcript usage
description: Quantify transcript isoforms and detect differential transcript usage. Scored on isoform abundance accuracy, DTU ranking and delta-PSI accuracy.

title: Latent-factor-adjusted differential expression
description: Differential expression adjusted for latent structure. The naive analysis finds many latent-driven genes; the task rewards recovering the real contrast without removing true effects.

title: Cell calling, doublets and ambient RNA
description: Call cells from raw barcodes, remove doublets and correct ambient RNA. Scored on cell-call F1, doublet ranking and ambient-profile agreement.

title: Cell-type annotation
description: Annotate cells against a labelled reference atlas at granular and major resolution. Scored on accuracy, macro-F1, adjusted Rand index and major-class accuracy.

title: Pseudobulk and cell-type composition
description: Aggregate sparse single-cell libraries into pseudobulk profiles and recover cell-type composition. Scored on composition distance, composition r-squared and pseudobulk correlation.

title: Cis-eQTL mapping with population structure
description: Map cis-eQTLs while controlling population structure and calibrating false discovery. Scored on power at a fixed FDR, calibration, effect accuracy and sign accuracy.

title: Splicing QTL mapping
description: Map splicing QTLs while controlling false discovery. Scored on power at a fixed FDR, effect accuracy and calibration.

title: Conditional eQTLs and multiple causal variants
description: Resolve multiple causal variants at a locus with conditional analysis. Scored on primary and secondary recall, precision and posterior inclusion ranking.

title: Trans-eQTL hotspots and core-gene ranking
description: Find trans-eQTL hotspots and rank their core genes. Scored on hotspot ranking, core-gene recovery and trans false-discovery control.

title: Co-expression network with latent confounders
description: Infer a co-expression network in the presence of latent confounders. Scored on direct-edge recovery, path recovery, sign accuracy and control of latent-driven false positives.

title: Confounder-adjusted GRN inference across replicates
description: A method task evaluated on five held-out replicates with different graph topologies, confounder strengths and latent density. Scored on the mean, with a variance penalty for unstable methods.

title: Directed network, latent confounders and core genes
description: Infer a directed network with latent confounders and identify core genes. Scored on edge direction, hub and core-gene ranking, and control of latent-driven edges.

title: Cis-eQTL fine mapping
description: Build 95% credible sets and posterior inclusion probabilities from eQTL summary statistics and an LD panel. Scored on coverage, set size, PIP ranking and calibration.

title: eQTL-GWAS colocalization
description: Distinguish shared causal signal from coincidental overlap using eQTL and GWAS summary statistics. Scored on H0-H4 hypothesis accuracy, H4 F1 and posterior quality.

title: Expression prediction and TWAS
description: Predict expression from genotype and use it for a transcriptome-wide association scan. Scored on expression accuracy, causal-gene recall and false-discovery control, so a well-calibrated negative result is not rewarded as a discovery.

title: Functional annotation of variants
description: Classify variants by regulatory function from incomplete chromatin, conservation and motif tracks. Scored on macro-F1 and motif-disruption ranking, so a model must separate real signal from missing annotation.

title: Stratified heritability enrichment
description: Estimate stratified heritability enrichment across annotation categories and report calibrated uncertainty. Scored on enrichment error, share error and confidence-interval coverage.

title: Cell-type-specific eQTL mapping
description: Map cell-type-specific expression QTLs from pseudobulk data. Scored on cell-type-specific ranking, effect agreement and false-discovery calibration.

title: Mendelian randomization of expression on traits
description: Estimate the causal effect of expression on a trait with Mendelian randomisation. Scored on effect bias, confidence-interval coverage and type-one error, so a confident but miscalibrated estimate loses.

title: Latent expression factors and loadings
description: Recover latent expression factors and their loadings across samples. Scored on factor and loading correlation, with sign and scale ambiguity handled by the grader.

title: Cell-type-resolved regulatory programs
description: Infer cell-type-resolved regulatory programs from multi-omic data. Scored on program ranking, cell-type specificity and recall.
